title: Nightly job reads the inventory

story.title: The job authenticated as itself
story.what: The job signed a short-lived JWT with its private key and asked for a token.
story.why: No user is involved; the workload is the principal.
story.matters: Key-based client auth means no shared secret to leak or rotate by hand.

story.title: The API saw a machine, not a person
story.what: The token's sub is the client itself.
story.why: Client credentials tokens carry no user identity.
story.matters: Grant these narrowly: there is no user whose limits bound them.

subtitle: OAuth 2.0 client credentials grant (machine to machine)

outcome.detail: The workload authenticated with its key and received a token scoped to inventory reads.
outcome.caption: client authenticated · token minted · API returned 200

tokens.label: Access token
tokens.note: sub is the client: there is no user in this token.
